stories.title: Jensen Huang Returns As Nvidia CEO Just 11 Days After Resigning: Here Is What Company Said
stories.summary: Jensen Huang, a co-founder of Nvidia, has resumed his roles as President and Chief Executive Officer. This return occurred only days after he had previously resigned from the leadership positions.

stories.title: OpenAI Engineer Secretly Recorded Dozens of Meetings, Prosecutors Say
stories.summary: Federal prosecutors are investigating an OpenAI engineer who allegedly recorded numerous company meetings without permission. The recordings reportedly included discussions about customers, AI safety, and a briefing with a foreign government, and authorities are looking into what happened to these recordings.

stories.title: SpaceX Sued By Oregon and Virginia Over A.I.-Generated Sexualized Images
stories.summary: Oregon and Virginia have filed lawsuits against SpaceX, alleging that the company's Grok Imagine artificial intelligence tool generated sexualized images. The states claim that this action violates consumer protection laws.

stories.title: Plaud India User Base Grows Over 3X In 2026, Here's How AI Devices Are Changing The Way Professionals Work
stories.summary: Plaud's user base in India has more than tripled in 2026, driven by an increasing demand for AI-powered productivity devices. The company plans to expand its presence in India, aiming for over 1 million users by 2030, which would make it Plaud's largest market in the Asia-Pacific region.

stories.title: Murf AI launches Finch tool for live transcription across 11 Indian languages: What it means for users
stories.summary: Murf AI has introduced a new tool called Finch, which offers live transcription services. This tool supports 11 different Indian languages, providing users with real-time speech-to-text capabilities.

stories.title: Stocks Surge After Jensen Huang Is Reinstated as Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: Stocks rose after Nvidia's former chief executive was reinstated. This news contributed to the market's recovery from a recent sell-off.

stories.title: Nvidia Sparks Historic Wall Street Rally: Shares Soar 35%, US Stocks Recover Nearly Half Of Last Week’s Losses
stories.summary: US stocks experienced a significant rebound, with the S&P 500 increasing, largely due to a surge in artificial intelligence stocks. Nvidia's shares saw a substantial rise, contributing to the market's recovery of a portion of its previous losses.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei Sells $280.41 Million Worth Of Shares After IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei sold a significant amount of shares following the company's initial public offering. This occurred while the company's stock experienced fluctuations after its market debut.

stories.title: India's Economic Activity Hits 4-Year High In October, But Rural Demand Remains Weak
stories.summary: India's economic activity reached a four-year high in October, showing a strong increase. However, the country faces ongoing challenges from weak demand in rural areas, increasing inflation, and tighter money supply.

stories.title: RBI Plans Digital Banking Safety Overhaul: New ‘Stop Switch’ Could Let Customers Block All Debits Instantly
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is planning to enhance digital banking security with new measures. These include an instant 'Stop Switch' that would allow customers to immediately block all debit transactions, along with other features like trusted-person verification and adjustable payment limits to combat fraud.

stories.title: Trump Puts Presidency on the Line to Reinstate Nvidia’s Jensen Huang
stories.summary: The headline reports that Trump is taking a significant political risk to support the reinstatement of Nvidia's Jensen Huang.

stories.title: 'NDA is now complete': BJP welcomes back 'oldest ally' Akali Dal ahead of Punjab polls
stories.summary: The BJP has announced that its alliance with the Akali Dal is now complete, welcoming back its long-standing partner in preparation for the upcoming Punjab elections.

stories.title: One every four minutes: New data suggests 720,000 Russian soldiers killed since start of Ukraine war
stories.summary: New data indicates that approximately 720,000 Russian soldiers have died since the beginning of the conflict in Ukraine, suggesting a high rate of casualties.

stories.title: Courts strike down international students’ stay cap, pause CPT limits
stories.summary: A recent court decision has removed the cap on how long international students can stay in the country and has also paused limits on Curricular Practical Training (CPT). This development affects international students by potentially offering more flexibility in their academic and professional paths in the United States.

stories.title: Worried about your H-1B renewal? New DHS proposal could affect 208,000 visa petitions
stories.summary: A new proposal from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) could impact approximately 208,000 H-1B visa renewal petitions. Individuals with H-1B visas who are considering renewal may need to pay attention to these potential changes.

stories.title: Iowa employers fear $103K H-1B visa fee will worsen worker shortage
stories.summary: Employers in Iowa are concerned that a proposed $103,000 fee for H-1B visas could worsen the existing worker shortage. This fee increase might make it more difficult for businesses to hire skilled foreign workers, potentially impacting the local economy.

stories.title: US H-1B visa curbs could hurt American workers in non-STEM jobs, study finds
stories.summary: A study suggests that restrictions on H-1B visas in the U.S. might negatively affect American workers in fields outside of science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). This indicates that visa policies can have broader implications for the domestic workforce beyond the directly targeted sectors.

stories.title: Democratic Control of Congress Could Reshape H-1B Visa Policy and U.S.-India Trade Relations
stories.summary: If Democrats gain control of Congress, it could lead to changes in H-1B visa policy and influence trade relations between the U.S. and India. This potential shift in political power might result in new approaches to immigration and international commerce.
